decisions.reason: The impact is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY updating battery_connector_placement; no stale attribute requires removal.
The USB-C connector is only a positional reference; the decision does not change its type, data lines, or sourceability requirements.
Relocating the battery connector does not change the charge-status indicator, GPIO, or separate-LED requirement.
The connector-placement change does not alter battery-protection modes or cutoff behavior.
Moving the battery connector does not change the requirement to monitor temperature through the battery NTC on J_BAT.
The mechanical relocation does not change boost-converter enable control, pull-down configuration, or powered-load behavior.
The battery-connector placement decision does not modify the TVS-based ESD protection requirement.
The battery-connector relocation is unrelated to I2C cable length, clock speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location.
The source changes only connector placement and makes no component-selection or availability decision.
